comment.zh: 轻量级跨平台数据库客户端，集成连接管理、SQL 编辑、数据表格和结构工具。请先安装 DBX，确认可执行文件路径后启用；Oracle、达梦、DB2 需要在 DBX 中安装对应驱动。
comment.en: Lightweight cross-platform database client with connection management, SQL editing, data grids and schema tools. Install DBX and verify the executable path before enabling. Oracle, Dameng and DB2 require their drivers in DBX.
